disease_state.evidence: The principal Alzheimer's disease biomarkers (e.g., tau protein, amyloid-β, apolipoprotein E, and neurogranin) were detected.
inferred: The present study establishes an in-depth CSF proteome through the analysis of a unique CSF sample from a pool of donors.

material_type.evidence: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is a body fluid of choice for biomarker studies of brain disorders but remains relatively under-studied compared with other biological fluids such as plasma, partly due to the more invasive means of its sample collection.
Ninety-six aliquots of 400 μL of the commercial pooled CSF sample (i.e., in total 38.4 mL of CSF) were evaporated.
